text:
Sara Kim: FYI — were GA-ing the Hosted Generative API: UnifiedGen endpoint today. This exposes a single /v1/gen endpoint that can route across model families (text, chat, and multimodal variants) and includes an adaptive fallback policy when a primary model is unavailable. Rolling out by region over ~3h. :tada:
Owen Blake: timeline + breaking changes?
Sara Kim: rollout window 14:00 PT -> 17:00 PT. No breaking changes for most customers: existing per-model endpoints continue to work for now, but we recommend migrating to /v1/gen to take advantage of unified routing and cheaper fallbacks.
Carlos Medina: ops concerns? will routing increase latency or request overhead?
eng-sre-bot: runbook added: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/unifiedgen-ga. Watch p95 token-latency +20% and route-fallback-rate >3% sustained 10m. Canary keys: gen-canary-01..08. Auto-rollback triggers defined in runbook.
Sara Kim: important opt-in headers for richer telemetry: `X-Redwood-Gen-Trace: 1` for sampled traces and `X-Redwood-Prefer-Fallback: cost` to bias routing toward lower-cost fallback variants.
billing-bot: note: normal gen usage billed as usual. Using `Prefer-Fallback: cost` may route to cheaper quantized variants; no extra charge. However opt-in exported traces (GenTraceDump) are billed under debug exports.
docs-bot: docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/unifiedgen (migration guide, curl + SDK snippets, routing policy docs)
Owen Blake: Dedicated / Private differences?
Sara Kim: Dedicated: admin flag in Console -> Admin -> Feature Flags -> UnifiedGenRouting. Private/on-prem: included in 2.0.0 private bundle; operators must run the routing agent migration script. See private upgrade notes in docs.
Carlos Medina: can we get a short curl example for eng channels?
Sara Kim: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Gen-Trace: 1" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","input":"Summarize the latest sales notes"}'
```
Owen Blake: deprecation plan?
Sara Kim: we will deprecate legacy per-model endpoint paths on 2026-11-15. Migration guides and a compatibility layer will be available; customers will get email notices before deprecation.
Carlos Medina: marketing / customer comms?
release-bot: Product + Marketing will send targeted emails to high-usage accounts and publish a changelog entry. Well also post a short demo and migration webinar.
Sara Kim: final: AMA at 15:00 PT in #product. If you see regressions during rollout, tag @eng-sre and include the canary key. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
